title: The Paper Regiment
author: Wendell Blackwood
blurb: Quentin Winterbourne, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
